question: I'm an IS sophomore on academic warning. I've completed 15-121 (Introduction to Data Structures) and 67-262 (Database Design and Development). Can I register for 67-272 (Application Design and Development) next semester?
expected_answer: Yes — 67-272 requires (15-122 at least D OR 15-121 at least D) AND (67-262 at least D). P-013 has both 15-121 and 67-262, so the prerequisite chain is satisfied. Note that 67-250 is listed as a co-requisite, but P-013 has already completed it in Spring 2025, so no issue there. Academic warning status does not block course registration, only overloads, study abroad, and independent studies.
common_mistake: Assuming 67-272 requires 15-122 specifically (it accepts 15-121 as an alternative); failing to check the co-requisite status of 67-250
needs_verification: Confirm P-013 passed 15-121 with at least a D
Confirm P-013 passed 67-262 with at least a D
Confirm P-013 completed 67-250 before this registration (co-req satisfied)
Confirm the exact grade threshold for the alternative prereq (15-121 vs 15-122)
